description: Lists the new launches this service covers: name, property type (condo or ec, an executive condominium), district, street, number of units, stage, launch date, whether it is sold out, and whether floor plans and area details are available. It covers a selection of launches during the trial. Every answer carries its source, the date it was reviewed, the stage of the launch, and the agent's licence details. Anything the developer material does not settle is returned as a gap with the question to ask, never as a guess.
name: list_launches
